title: Canva Week-of-Posts Playbook
tldr: Set a brand voice once, write seven drafts with Magic Write, build them with Bulk Create, schedule in the Content Planner.
Check your Canva plan: brand voice and Bulk Create depend on it.

tools.name: Canva
tools.note: Brand voice and Bulk Create depend on your plan

steps.title: Set your brand voice
steps.detail: Homepage: Brand, Brand Kits, Brand voice. Save short guidelines.

steps.title: Write seven drafts
steps.detail: Select text, press slash, choose Magic Write. Edit and fact check every draft.

steps.title: Build one template
steps.detail: One text box per data field, then prepare a table with one row per post.

steps.title: Run Bulk Create
steps.detail: Connect data, preview, then Create designs. Desktop only.

steps.title: Resize if needed
steps.detail: Use Magic Resize, then check text and faces are still clear.

steps.title: Schedule the week
steps.detail: Homepage: More, Content Planner, Add New, Post. Instagram needs a desktop browser.

checklist: Seven drafts edited and fact checked
Template has one text box per field
